I am sorry to hear you are in pain. To help me understand what is going on, can you tell me if this pain started suddenly and if it is located specifically on the right side of your lower abdomen?

Also, have you noticed any fever, nausea, or changes in your bowel habits recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; given your history of unprotected sex, have you experienced any urinary symptoms like burning or frequency, or any changes in your discharge? Also, have you noticed any vaginal bleeding or spotting recently? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, CBC, and STI panel.
